WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-18' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sale_date, f.channel_code, f.store_key, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id = (SELECT min(g.sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line g WHERE g.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND g.line_no=f.line_no) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS extra_copies,
       sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
GROUP BY ROLLUP(f.sale_date, f.channel_code, f.store_key)
ORDER BY 1,2,3
LIMIT 60

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_year AS (
    SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_year ty
JOIN by_year ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.category

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cat_is, n.cat_was, count(*) AS n_lines, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id = 900 THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS web_part
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
  AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR n.cat_was IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
